chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a Moroccan man in his early 30s, short black hair, neatly trimmed black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s, dark brown hair in a loose bun, wearing a teal satin house kaftan with white embroidered trim

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Seen from the half-open bedroom doorway: HUSBAND sits on the edge of a single bed in his old childhood bedroom in a Moroccan family house in Safi, nervously unlocking a smartphone in a pink case that is plugged into a charger cable from the wall, his face lit by the screen, guilty curious expression, glancing toward the door. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Close shot over the shoulder of HUSBAND holding the pink-cased smartphone with a cracked corner in both hands, screen glowing blank light blue, his tense face in profile, sweat drop, dim bedroom with old football poster shapes behind. No text, no letters on the screen.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Small modern Moroccan apartment living room in Safi, evening: HUSBAND at the front door putting on his shoes, saying goodbye with a forced smile, while WIFE sits on a sofa with a baby in a pink blanket on her lap, looking tired and distracted, not noticing her phone is missing. Both faces visible, subjects in the centre. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. HUSBAND quietly closes the wooden door of his old childhood bedroom from the inside, holding the pink-cased phone and a charger, looking back over his shoulder to check nobody follows, warm lamp light, a family dinner glow visible through the gap of the door. Face visible. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. HUSBAND lying on his stomach on the single bed, scrolling the pink-cased phone with one thumb, concentrated frown, phone screen showing colourful blurry square photo tiles (no letters), cosy dim bedroom. Face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. HUSBAND sitting cross-legged on the bed, shrugging with a relieved half smile, holding the pink-cased phone away from himself, a sense of 'nothing here', soft lamp light. Face visible. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Dramatic close-up of HUSBAND's face lit green by the pink-cased phone screen, eyes widening, eyebrows raised, mouth slightly open in shock, dark bedroom around him. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. HUSBAND sitting up straight on the bed, thumb scrolling fast, a long column of chat bubble shapes (green and white, no letters) streaming on the pink-cased phone screen, his face anxious and pale. Face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Extreme tension: HUSBAND holds the pink-cased phone close to his face, his index finger hovering just above the glowing screen, about to tap, sweat on his forehead, the bedroom dark except the phone glow. Face visible. No text.
